sections.name: TicketDemo
sections.title: Sample call card
sections.what: Draws one sample call card with fixed text and a fake lock that resolves after 300 milliseconds. Nothing is saved.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the gallery show the card without real data.
sections.watch_out: Real locks go to the server; do not copy this fake lock into live pages.

summary: A sample copy of the call card with fixed cricket values, used only in the design gallery.
purpose: Lets the developer see the call card's look and behaviour without real match data.
why: The comment says it is for the gallery only. Otherwise the reason is not stated.
how: Draws the Ticket component with a question, four context values, a leverage meter and two options. Its lock action waits 300 milliseconds and saves nothing.
inputs: None; all values are fixed text inside the file.
outputs: A sample call card on the design page.
risks: The sample scenario looks like a real match, so it could be mistaken for data. The lock does not record anything, unlike the real lock.
debug: If the card looks wrong, check the Ticket props. If the lock hangs, check the 300 millisecond delay.
